newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - LSI Logic EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - LSI Logic EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co Inc said it cut its 1997 earnings view on LSI Logic Corp to $1.50 a share from $1.60 a share.
-- set a 1998 estimate of $1.80 a share.
-- said LSI's fourth quarter revenues were "relatively flat."
-- said revenues are not expected to show significant improvement until the second half of 1997.
-- LSI posted fourth quarter earnings of $0.23 per diluted share on revenues of $301 million, compared with $0.51 per diluted share on revenues of $349 million last year.
-- LSI gained 2-1/4 to 35-7/8 in morning trading.
